source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("ride-hailing" OR "ride hailing" OR ridesourcing OR "ride-sourcing" OR (ridesharing AND urban)) OR ("mobility as a service" OR "mobility-as-a-service" OR (MaaS AND transport)) OR (("transit app" OR "journey planner" OR "real-time information" OR "smart card") AND (transit OR "public transport")) OR (("digital ticketing" OR "mobile ticketing" OR "fare integration" OR "contactless payment") AND transit) OR ((micromobility OR "e-scooter" OR "bike-sharing" OR dockless) AND (urban OR city) AND (equity OR governance OR regulation))

oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and title-abstract has ("mobility as a service" OR "ride hailing" OR "mobility-as-a-service" OR "ride-hailing" OR "ride-sourcing" OR "ridesourcing" OR ("MaaS" AND "transport") OR ("ridesharing" AND "urban") OR ("transit" AND ("contactless payment" OR "digital ticketing" OR "fare integration" OR "mobile ticketing")) OR (("journey planner" OR "real-time information" OR "smart card" OR "transit app") AND ("public transport" OR "transit")) OR (("bike-sharing" OR "dockless" OR "e-scooter" OR "micromobility") AND ("city" OR "urban") AND ("equity" OR "governance" OR "regulation")))
